key.text: I want to make a phone stand for my desk out of wood. It should hold my phone at a slight angle, fit in my hand, and I only need one.

output.summary: A small phone stand cut from a flat sheet of plywood.

needs.why: To cut flat pieces precisely from a sheet of wood.

routes.process: Cut flat pieces from plywood and slot them together.
routes.fit_reason: The laser cutter makes quick, precise cuts for beginners. Plywood is easy to assemble into a sturdy stand.

steps.title: Design the pieces
steps.detail: Draw the flat parts of your stand in a vector design program.

steps.title: Cut the wood
steps.detail: Use the laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely) to cut your pieces from a plywood sheet.

steps.title: Assemble the stand
steps.detail: Slot the cut pieces together to form the finished phone stand.

warnings.issue: Laser cutters can burn certain materials if settings are wrong.
warnings.fix: Ask staff for help with the correct power settings for plywood.
